question: Build a trailing-twelve-month (TTM) comp table for four U.S. restaurant companies: Darden Restaurants, Brinker International, Cracker Barrel Old Country Store and The Cheesecake Factory. For each company compute TTM revenue (total revenues / net sales) and TTM GAAP net income attributable to the company, both in USD millions, through the company's most recent fiscal quarter reported as of October 3, 2026. Define TTM as the last four reported fiscal quarters, i.e. latest fiscal year + current fiscal year-to-date - prior-year year-to-date (when the most recent reported quarter is the fiscal fourth quarter, TTM equals that fiscal year); do not adjust for 52/53-week differences. State the TTM end date used for each company.
grading: Graded cell by cell: each value within tolerance and for the stated period; a missing cell counts as wrong.
answer:
TTM through each company's most recent reported quarter (USD millions):
| Row | TTM revenue | TTM net income |
|---|---|---|
| Darden Restaurants (TTM ended 2026-08-30) | 13,366.5 | 1,182.3 |
| Brinker International (TTM ended 2026-06-24) | 5,807.4 | 487.0 |
| Cracker Barrel Old Country Store (TTM ended 2026-07-31) | 3,318.7 | 31.7 |
| The Cheesecake Factory (TTM ended 2026-06-30) | 3,877.3 | 178.6 |
